findings.note: The model requires recording a missing-baseline gap and requesting owner revalidation, but does not record the FR-006-required owner determination of whether a shared baseline is relevant and what follow-up is appropriate. The quickstart's review checklist likewise omits that disposition.

The plan treats the spec as approved based on user confirmation and a lifecycle record, while the reviewed spec says Status: Draft. Those approval sources are not among the permitted review artifacts, so the planning-input authority cannot be independently verified here.
